description: This file defines the MakeNextSeqId class, a method operation used within the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework to generate and update the next sequence identifier for entities. It includes functionality for expanding expressions, validating attributes, and invoking the delegator to set the next sequence ID.

classes.name: MakeNextSeqId
classes.description: A method operation class that creates or updates sequence IDs for entities using configurable parameters such as sequence field name, increment value, and numeric padding.

classes.name: MakeNextSeqId.MakeNextSeqIdFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating instances of MakeNextSeqId from XML elements.

methods.name: MakeNextSeqId(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML attributes, validating and preparing expression expanders.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext methodContext)
methods.description: Executes the operation by retrieving the entity value, calculating the next sequence ID, and setting it via the delegator.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MakeNextSeqId element with its attributes.
